name: Augmented GD
description: Turn every level into a roguelite run. Die, draft an augment, get stronger, and finally beat it.

issues.info: Report bugs, ideas and questions on the GitHub issues page, or by email to seojoonrp@gmail.com.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of the augment cards, notices and run menus. Text already on screen switches the next time it is shown.

sound-effects.name: Sound effects
sound-effects.description: The mod's own sounds: hovering over and picking a draft card, and the Air Raid missile's blast. They follow GD's SFX volume.

draft-bar-opacity.name: Draft bar opacity
draft-bar-opacity.description: Opacity of the draft gauge at the bottom of the screen, in percent. Turn it down if the bar hides the level behind it.

keybind-slowmo.name: Toggle Slow-Mo
keybind-slowmo.description: Toggles the Sloth augment's slow-mo on/off during a run.

keybind-checkpoint.name: Place Checkpoint
keybind-checkpoint.description: Places a checkpoint (Checkpoint augment) during a run.

keybind-brake.name: Brake (hold)
keybind-brake.description: Hold to slow the game down (Brake augment) during a run.
